content.user_title: Generate Nano Banana 2 Images on RunComfy
content.value_statement: Image teams need fast drafts with predictable framing and readable text. This skill routes Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to Nano Banana 2 on RunComfy with focused prompt settings.
actual_capabilities: Runs text-to-image requests through the local RunComfy CLI.
Supports prompt, image count, seed, aspect ratio, resolution, format, safety tolerance, and web search settings.
Generates one to four still images per request.
Provides prompt patterns for product cards, social thumbnails, portraits, and in-image text.
Explains when to choose Nano Banana 2 versus sibling image models.
limitations: Requires an installed RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and valid authentication.
Sends prompt data to RunComfy when the user runs the generated command.
Text-to-image only; editing and video are outside this skill.
Higher resolutions and web search can increase cost and latency.

use_cases.title: Draft campaign visuals
use_cases.description: Create quick thumbnail variants with aspect ratios for ads, posts, and landing pages.

use_cases.title: Build social concepts
use_cases.description: Generate vertical or square image batches with consistent style and readable text.

use_cases.title: Prototype visual directions
use_cases.description: Compare prompt directions before requesting polished assets from a designer.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Nano Banana 2 on RunComfy to generate one 1K square image: [describe the subject, setting, and style].

prompt_templates.title: Generate Social Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Create four 9:16 draft images for [campaign or topic]. Keep the style consistent and make each composition distinct.

prompt_templates.title: Refine With Text and Seed
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate refinement after choosing a direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rerun the selected concept with the same seed. Add the exact text "[headline]" at [placement] in [font style].

prompt_templates.title: Use Web-Grounded Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that depends on current public information.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a web-grounded image about [current event or real entity]. Use Nano Banana 2 and note any extra latency or cost.

output_examples.input: Create a square product image for a matte black mug with the words Brewed Quietly.
output_examples.output: A one-image 1K PNG draft with quoted typography guidance and centered product composition.

output_examples.input: Make four vertical wellness ad concepts for social stories.
output_examples.output: A four-image 9:16 draft batch at 0.5K for quick selection and follow-up refinement.

output_examples.input: Create a current-event editorial thumbnail about a named public announcement.
output_examples.output: A web-grounded image request with extra latency noted and current context included in the prompt.

best_practices: Start with the main subject, then add environment, camera, style, and output constraints.
Quote exact in-image text and specify placement and font style.
Use low resolution for exploration, then rerun the winning prompt at 2K or 4K.
anti_patterns: Do not put secrets, private customer data, or unpublished business details in prompts.
Do not enable web search unless the prompt depends on current facts.
Do not request unsupported aspect ratios, resolutions, or more than four outputs.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps an AI assistant generate still images with Nano Banana 2 through RunComfy.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Do I need a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. The local RunComfy CLI needs a logged-in account or a valid token.

faq.question: Does it send data outside my machine?
faq.answer: Yes. When run, prompts are sent to the RunComfy Model API over HTTPS.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: No. This skill covers text-to-image generation only and points to a sibling edit skill.

faq.question: When should I enable web search?
faq.answer: Enable it only for prompts that need current facts or real-world public context.
